mask_protocol.layout: Keep all input IDs, passage count, token positions, and non-target attention entries fixed; interventions only set selected attention-mask entries to false.
mask_protocol.link_span: For every fine passage, locate exactly the filtered lexical-token sequence after the leading 'item:' label. Delimiter tokens removed by CollatorGRAM are not counted.
mask_protocol.cf_span: Locate in order every filtered lexical-token sequence between 'similar items:' and the following metadata separator.
mask_protocol.metadata_control: For each passage and replicate, choose without replacement the same number of active alphanumeric metadata-token positions as the link span, after the CF list and before EOS, ordered by SHA256(seed|dataset|user|passage|replicate|position).
mask_protocol.target_independence: No target token, target ID, target popularity, target rank, or test field may enter role localization or control selection.

decision_rule.execution_invalid: Any integrity, lineage, exact role localization, matched-control eligibility, finite-value, or repeatability check fails.
decision_rule.stop_no_raw_echo: Either dataset fails raw_link_harm mean, strict lower CI, or positive-rate gate.
decision_rule.stop_no_role_specificity: Either dataset fails adjusted_link_echo mean or strict lower CI.
decision_rule.stop_metadata_not_separable: Either dataset fails metadata_benefit mean or strict lower CI.
decision_rule.stop_no_failure_link: Either dataset fails failure_association mean or strict lower CI.
decision_rule.mechanism_allowed: All preceding gates pass on both datasets.
